description: chinamax session-lifecycle and Bridge-enforcement hooks. Jobs are session-scoped (ADR 0004, reversed 2026-07-30). SessionStart writes the session-liveness registry, reaps orphaned Jobs of dead sessions, and injects the running/recent Job digest (exporting CHINAMAX_SESSION_ID + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA); its matcher includes clear (re-inject after /clear wipes context) and fork (a forked session must register its own owner). SessionEnd kills the ending session's active Jobs and removes its registry entry — clear reaps like an exit. Stop emits a non-blocking running-Jobs notice. UserPromptSubmit injects the live-Bridge roster and the explicit-addressing routing rule into main. PreToolUse (Bash) re-injects the Bridge classification contract into the chinamax Bridge as subagent-scoped context (ADR 0010, no hard blocks).
